svg.title: 02 Users and reference data | Warehouse Returns ERD
svg.desc: Warehouse returns database design based on functional requirements version 2.1. Relationship types use 1:1, 1:N, N:1, and N:M notation; optional participation is explained separately.
svg.text: Users, audit history and shared reference values
FRD 2.1 | 5 supporting tables | Small grey boxes repeat entities from tab 01; they are not additional tables
An active role is required to act.
RecordKey is a description, not a generic FK.
No separate tables for each list.
Derived for RQ-04; not a stored item attribute.
Separate cash amounts from restock estimates.
Actor relationships | every target is on tab 01
Reference relationships | one shared parent table
Cross-page aliases repeat the existing User, ReferenceValue,
and operational entities. They do not create additional tables.
A nullable FK has partial participation; required FKs have total
participation. Every parent may have no dependent records.
Validate Domain + IsActive in controlled writes; an FK alone
does not prevent choosing a value from the wrong category.
Preserve referenced IDs, codes and domains. Inactive values
remain visible in history. Do not deactivate codes needed by
open work or enabled workflow transitions.
PK = primary key (underlined) FK = foreign key UK = unique key NULL = nullable; other attributes required.
Endpoint 1 / N / M = maximum cardinality. T = total participation (double line); P = partial participation (single line).
1:N and N:1 are opposite readings of one relationship. Optionality is separate from maximum cardinality.
Proposed MySQL types: INT / BIGINT / SMALLINT are UNSIGNED; TS = DATETIME(6); MONEY = DECIMAL(12,2);
Vn = VARCHAR(n); BOOL = TINYINT(1). Composite FKs use all listed columns together. Dates use the warehouse time zone.
